cohort: Women experiencing maternal mortality and near-miss maternal morbidity at the University Teaching Hospital (CHUK) in Kigali, Rwanda, from October 1, 2012-October 31, 2013.
finding: Sepsis was the most common cause of both maternal mortality (32%) and near-miss morbidity (30%).
mod_finding: 46% of sepsis cases resulting in death were status post cesarean section.
